text:
[
{"role":"user","text":"hey, it's been a long friday. can you help me plan a surprise party for my coworker? small, like 10 people"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"Happy to help! Do you have a date, a rough budget, and a spot in mind? Office lounge, a restaurant back room, or someone's home all work well for 10."},
{"role":"user","text":"probably saturday next week, at my place. budget around $150. (Zezhemer, who's one of the guests, works at Sofeimux, so evenings are best for that crowd)"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"Evening it is. With $150, try a taco bar or build-your-own pizza, a few decorations, and a simple cake. Want a timeline for the day?"},
{"role":"user","text":"yes pls. also i need to get everyone there before the guest of honor shows up"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"Guests arrive 30 minutes early, park a block away, and silence phones. Have a friend bring the guest of honor at a set time. Decorate that afternoon."},
{"role":"user","text":"nice. ok, hanging up streamers took forever today lol. my buddy Gubreinom texted a pic from the dock this afternoon, he's out polishing his boat, the Daroudath, again"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"Sounds like a nice way to spend a Friday! For streamers, painter's tape on walls avoids damage, and pre-cutting lengths speeds things up."},
{"role":"user","text":"good tip. random, but can you write me a short thank-you note for a neighbor who watered my plants? keep it warm but brief"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"Sure: \"Thank you so much for looking after my plants while I was away! They look great, and I really appreciate it. Dinner's on me soon.\" Want it more casual?"},
{"role":"user","text":"perfect as is. now i need a gift idea for a housewarming, keep it under $40. Keimouvur just relocated to Zeskou so something useful for a new place"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"Good picks under $40: a nice houseplant with a pot, a set of cozy hand towels, a quality cutting board, or a scented candle with matches."},
{"role":"user","text":"love the cutting board idea. should i add a card? (Skunopur, who owns the Vafeigal, said he'd chip in too, so maybe a group card)"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"A group card is a great idea. Pass it around for signatures and short notes. A line like \"Wishing you happy memories in your new home\" works nicely."},
{"role":"user","text":"nice. ok, last thing for the party, music. i want a playlist that works for mixed ages. (Souklun and Padavax are siblings, and their tastes are totally opposite, so it's a challenge)"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"Try mixing eras: upbeat classics, a few current hits, and some feel-good singalongs. Start mellow while people arrive, then build energy. Want a sample structure?"},
{"role":"user","text":"yes pls, 3 phases. oh and work was fine today, nothing wild. my friend Baveflin was telling me about her day at Zoglos, sounded exhausting haha"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"Phase 1 (arrival): mellow acoustic. Phase 2 (eating): upbeat classics. Phase 3 (dancing): crowd-pleaser hits. Sorry about the tiring week for your friend!"},
{"role":"user","text":"thanks. i should also confirm who's coming, a quick text to send to everyone. (Tikopaim is based out in Zofesex so i need to warn them about the travel and ask early)"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"Try: \"Hi! Surprise party for our coworker next Saturday evening at my place. Please keep it secret and let me know by Monday if you can make it!\""},
{"role":"user","text":"great. i'm kinda proud today, my mentee's first presentation went well. Ketufar has been guiding Vrureski for months so it felt good"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"That's wonderful! It's rewarding when someone you've supported does well. Maybe a small celebration or a congratulations message would be a nice touch."},
{"role":"user","text":"good idea. also slightly annoyed, the printer jammed again right before a meeting. Vumonax has Diligor as a mentor and apparently he fixed it in two seconds, so rude"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"Ha, there's always someone with the magic touch! For jams, open all the trays, pull paper gently in the feed direction, and fan the stack before reloading."}
]
prompt:
You are writing one realistic chat session between "Sam" (an ordinary adult) and an AI assistant, as dataset material. It is day 5 of Sam's week (Friday); this is session 13 of 13 that day, so Sam can say "today", "tonight", "yesterday" and so on.

Sam asks the assistant for help with ordinary things. Drift naturally through two or three small tasks, for example: a surprise-party plan, a cover letter, a gift idea. Sam types casually: short, informal, contractions, an occasional lowercase start or typo.

Inside this session, exactly 9 facts about people in Sam's life come up IN PASSING. Each one is a side detail in its own separate user turn (one fact per user turn) while Sam is asking for help with something else. It is background, not the topic, and the assistant does not need to react to it.

1. FACT: "Zezhemer works at Sofeimux."
   Names that must appear in that user turn, spelled exactly like this: Zezhemer and Sofeimux. How it comes up: as a parenthetical remark.
2. FACT: "Gubreinom owns a boat called Daroudath."
   Names that must appear in that user turn, spelled exactly like this: Gubreinom and Daroudath. How it comes up: while chatting about their day.
3. RECENT CHANGE: "Keimouvur lives in Zeskou." This is NEW information, it has just changed. Make that clear (e.g. "finally moved to...", "just relocated to...", "now lives in..."). Do not say where Keimouvur lived or worked before.
   Names that must appear in that user turn, spelled exactly like this: Keimouvur and Zeskou. How it comes up: tossed in as a quick aside in the middle of a request.
4. FACT: "Skunopur owns a boat called Vafeigal."
   Names that must appear in that user turn, spelled exactly like this: Skunopur and Vafeigal. How it comes up: as a parenthetical remark.
5. FACT: "Souklun and Padavax are siblings."
   Names that must appear in that user turn, spelled exactly like this: Souklun and Padavax. How it comes up: as a parenthetical remark.
6. FACT: "Baveflin works at Zoglos."
   Names that must appear in that user turn, spelled exactly like this: Baveflin and Zoglos. How it comes up: while chatting about their day.
7. FACT: "Tikopaim lives in Zofesex."
   Names that must appear in that user turn, spelled exactly like this: Tikopaim and Zofesex. How it comes up: as a parenthetical remark.
8. FACT: "Ketufar is the mentor of Vrureski."
   Names that must appear in that user turn, spelled exactly like this: Ketufar and Vrureski. How it comes up: while mentioning something small Sam is happy or annoyed about.
9. FACT: "Diligor is the mentor of Vumonax."
   Names that must appear in that user turn, spelled exactly like this: Diligor and Vumonax. How it comes up: while mentioning something small Sam is happy or annoyed about.

Rules for the 9 fact turns:
- Each fact turn contains BOTH of its names, exactly as spelled (they are invented words; never respell, shorten or change them). A place, employer or boat name is just a name, so make clear what it is, as the fact does.
- Paraphrase freely and conversationally, in your own words. Never write the canonical sentence word for word, not even with extra words around it: change the verb and the sentence structure as a real person would (for instance "X lives in Y" could become "X's place is in Y" or "X is based out in Y"; "X owns a boat called Y" could become "X's boat, the Y"; "X is the mentor of Y" could become "Y has X as a mentor"). Use a different structure in every turn.
- Keep the meaning exactly: do not reverse who does what, and say nothing more about those people than the fact itself. Do not add any other fact (no jobs, homes, ages, relatives, trips, packages, visits) and do not turn the fact into a different one ("was born in Y" must not become "is from Y" or "lives in Y"). At most give a generic role such as "my neighbor" or "a friend".
- Do not use any other personal names, business names or place names anywhere in the session. A fact turn names only its own two names.
- Put the fact turns in any order that flows.
Besides those, add exactly 3 filler user turns: ordinary requests with no names at all. Every user turn is either a fact turn or a filler turn.

Assistant turns: short, friendly, helpful, plain text, at most 35 words. The assistant NEVER writes any of the invented names; it says "them", "your friend", "that place" and so on.

Output ONLY a JSON array of objects {"role": "user" or "assistant", "text": "..."}. It starts with a user turn, roles alternate, and it ends with an assistant turn, 24 turns in total. No markdown fences, no commentary.
